en.title: Maximum Sum of a Non-Empty Contiguous Segment
en.description:
Choose a non-empty contiguous segment of an integer array and output the maximum sum of its elements. Even for an all-negative array, the empty segment may not be chosen.

See the input protocol for this site's supplements to missing ranges and its recovery of typos in the source.
en.input: First n is given, followed by n integers. The original gave no numeric bounds; this site publicly adds 1≤n≤200000 and −10^9≤a[i]≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 5; -2; 0. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Maintain the best non-empty segment sum ending at the current element, and also the maximum over all ending positions.
